title: Short-Notice Raise on Mold Remediation Signing Deposits
content:
Term of the Mold Remediation agreement: the deposit notice is the scheduled start date less the signing date in calendar days. A deposit notice of at most 2 days (the rush notice days) raises the deposit by 20 percent (the rush notice percentage) of the tier's self-pay deposit, rounded to the cent, half up, but never by less than the rush notice minimum of 200.00; a deposit notice above 2 days and at most 5 days (the short notice days) raises it by the flat short notice raise of 100.00; any longer deposit notice takes no notice raise.

| Deposit notice (calendar days) | Raise |
|---|---|
| 2 or fewer | The larger of 200.00 and 20 percent of the tier's self-pay deposit (rounded to the cent, half up) |
| 3, 4 or 5 | 100.00 |
| 6 or more | None |

**Examples on hypothetical figures.**

- Signed 1 day before the scheduled start, tier self-pay deposit 1340.00: 20 percent is 268.00, above 200.00, so the raise is 268.00.
- Signed 2 days before the scheduled start, tier self-pay deposit 640.00: 20 percent is 128.00, below 200.00, so the raise is 200.00.
- Signed 5 days before the scheduled start: 100.00. Signed 6 days before: no raise.
